### US defense manufacturer IEH hit by phishing attack
<span class="imp imp-3" title="Importance 3/5" aria-label="Importance 3 of 5"><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i class="on"></i><i></i><i></i></span> Anthropic will make Claude Code's autonomous 'auto mode' the default for paid Pro, Max, and Team plans starting August 14, 2026, citing safety data showing it outperforms human review.

<ul class="takeaways">
<li>Auto mode caught 89% of dangerous commands vs 13.6% by human reviewers in a 1,053-tester study</li>
<li>720 prompt injection attacks tested by Trajectory Labs — none succeeded</li>
<li>Users approve 97% of permission prompts, often reflexively after many prompts</li>
<li>Auto mode users ship ~25% more pull requests</li>
<li>Reverts to manual approval after 3 consecutive or 20 total session blocks</li>
</ul>

Sources: [Claude by Anthropic](https://claude.com/blog/auto-mode-default-in-claude-code) <span class="src-badge src-research">Research</span>, [The Record from Recorded Future News](https://therecord.media/military-device-manufacturer-discloses-cyber-incident) <span class="src-badge src-research">Research</span>, [The Register](https://www.theregister.com/security/2026/08/07/ieh-corp-says-phished-staffer-opened-gates-to-company-m365/) <span class="src-badge src-research">Research</span>, [securityaffairs.com](https://news.google.?oc=5) <span class="src-badge src-rss">RSS</span>
